evals.prompt: How do I prove this UI overflow bug is actually fixed?
evals.expectedBehavior: Require a live computed-style / DOM assertion on the rendered page (e.g. scrollWidth <= clientWidth). Refuse a source diff as proof for a UI bug.

evals.prompt: Can I just close this rendered bug with the git diff of my CSS change?
evals.expectedBehavior: No. Flag VERIFICATION_LAYER_MISMATCH: a rendered bug never closes on a source diff; demand layer-appropriate live proof.

evals.prompt: The adapter can build but can't run the app here. What state can this bug reach?
evals.expectedBehavior: ASSIST tier: emit handoff/v0 and stop at candidate, never closed (no runner -> no auto-close).

evals.prompt: Generate a full unit-test suite for a brand-new feature.
evals.expectedBehavior: Do NOT trigger verification — there is no fixed bug whose proof needs selecting.

evals.prompt: Set up a CI pipeline from scratch for my repo.
evals.expectedBehavior: Do NOT trigger verification — this is infrastructure setup, not bug-fix proof selection.
